policy: Product-flow UI readability/layout density debt may burn down but cannot increase. New dense long-copy/no-wrap controls fail closed.

rules.message: Content-heavy Button/choice controls must allow wrapping; use h-auto/min-h + whitespace-normal/break-words for long Chinese copy.
Long Chinese action/choice copy cannot be squeezed into h-8/h-9 fixed-height controls.
Long business copy must not be hidden by truncate; use line-clamp, wrapping, title, or disclosure.
Two-column dense cards cannot combine tiny typography with long Chinese business copy.
Long business copy should not use leading-tight; prefer leading-relaxed/normal for readability.
